name: pawn-break-public
description: Automatically open an embedded chess puzzle when Codex starts a task.

interface.longDescription: Pawn Break asks Codex to open a chess puzzle at the start of every task while the plugin is enabled. When Codex sends completion, the automatic board shows Getting back to the chat… for 1.5 seconds and requests closure. Boards opened explicitly stay open. Opening and closing depend on the agent following the skill and the host supporting closure. Ask Codex to stop automatic opening in this chat, or disable the plugin in host settings. Play, request hints, retry or advance on the board. Five clean solves raise rating by 100, up to 2500. Progress stays locally. No registration is required.
defaultPrompt: Open Pawn Break while I work.
